verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents its own A/R capability: it tracks invoices and payments, flags delinquent accounts, and runs an A/R aging report showing which customers are late. Customer statements add per-customer follow-up. Explicit per-customer outstanding balance views are only implied by the customer-level aging and statements, so story coverage is not complete. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-customer balance tracking or views, detail on aging report buckets and customization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances

citations.quote: QuickBooks makes it easy to run the A/R aging report to see which customers are late with their payments
QuickBooks helps you manage accounts receivable by tracking invoices, payments, and identifying your delinquent accounts.
In just a few clicks you can send statement reminders to customers that are late paying you.
